cases.prompt: Start a new standalone Tama Terraform graph with a messaging surface, model provider, and router in an otherwise empty repository.
invariants: Establishes exactly one root upmaru/base/tama global foundation before dependent graph modules
Pins a root-module version verified for the target provider and repository instead of copying an unrelated helper version
Uses installed global outputs for the global space, shared schemas, and corpora instead of recreating them
Adds explicit foundation dependencies only where output references do not infer them
Checks ownership and plan impact before creating global resources in an existing environment

cases.prompt: Add a routed inventory-search behavior to an existing Tama messaging root. The component calls a search action and can return either plain text or an artifact through shared root reply chains.
invariants: Inventories the existing messaging, router, listener, component, and reply topology before editing
Adds a semantic forwardable class, router path, directional bridges, reactive node, and listener filter
Adds tooling and post-tool routing with terminals for plain and artifact outcomes
Attaches an artifact-specific path directive to the shared root artifact thought
Does not duplicate the shared root reply chain

cases.prompt: Build a Tama search surface where every user message is forwarded to a component that creates a UI search artifact. No conversational reply is required.
invariants: Chooses direct forwarding instead of a router
Creates only the root-to-component and component-to-UI bridges required by the graph
Treats the external artifact action as the terminal
Does not invent a component-to-root bridge or reply chain

cases.prompt: Extend an existing product-details ingestion network with an independently operable service-details domain. It needs credits, keywords, nested children, generated description and setting embeddings, processed indexing, and manual reruns.
invariants: Builds a parity matrix before implementation
Uses independent classes, actions, relations, crawlers, nodes, and index preload contracts
Includes fan-out crawlers, extraction, spread, relation building, awaited enrichment, and embeddings
Includes reactive and explicit nodes plus class-level path activation
Includes processed indexing with queue, preloader, stable document ID, and pruning
Does not couple the new domain to the existing domain for convenience

cases.prompt: Audit a routed Tama component whose artifact return path exists, but artifact rendering is wrong and class-level reprocessing never starts.
invariants: Separates execution paths from control edges
Checks path directives and their target thoughts
Checks class-processing thought paths for path activations
Reports exact evidence, impact, and smallest remediation without editing

cases.prompt: Remove an obsolete routed behavior and rename its replacement chain without recreating the remote chain or damaging the shared reply flow.
invariants: Traces upstream router outputs and downstream shared consumers
Removes prompt outputs, paths, filters, directives, and handlers in dependency order
Uses a moved block for the address-only chain rename
Preserves shared root reply resources
Requires plan review for deletes and replacements

cases.prompt: Verify whether a processed indexing graph is complete and whether indexing is working in production using only Terraform source.
invariants: Can prove or disprove static processed-event wiring
Checks corpus, preload, action, queue, bridge, pruning, and stable identity
Reports credentials, workers, remote indexes, mappings, and successful execution as runtime unknowns
Does not claim production success from static Terraform
